winner.title: Rehearsal Before the Season
winner.logline: One portable research control lets a researcher explore two separate simulated pollock scenarios, then places the discovered policies and their predefined comparisons before the same next-test goals.
winner.valence: Earned curiosity and optimism about policy discovery as research.
winner.why: The enthusiast supplies the most usable central performance: a researcher handles one existing control through changing research states. It leads with the real accomplishment, has a physically continuous hero and a hopeful earned return, and is feasible with the current shelf. Its original smoothness detour fails the padding test and is removed in full. The winning film is the revised lever-led research rehearsal; the grafts improve its mechanism and argument without replacing its identity.
binding_changes: Start inside the laboratory, with the apparatus explicitly labeled SIMULATED / EDITORIAL SCHEMATIC before the first harbor view.
Remove the entire smoother-policy-response animation, narration, calendar correction and corresponding gag. The Ricker catch/biomass reversal supplies the second movement.

Use two spatially separate experiment stations. Moving the same control changes the editorial research viewpoint; it does not transplant one trained policy. Each station introduces its own learned candidate and predefined comparison.
After the distinct reversal, give learned and predefined candidates the same visible next-test requirements. No scores, pass/fail lamps, approval marks, or operational launch.
Retain the affirmative research payoff: explicit alternatives worth comparing, with operational work ahead.

judgment_by_pitch.comedian: Strongest original scroll-stop, gags and changing prop; equal-candidate test is valuable. A new trophy adds construction/readability cost and risks imputing researcher boosterism or repeating award/credential framing. Runner-up.
judgment_by_pitch.dramatist: Best scale tension and separate basins. Toy-boat launch suspense is predictable, and learning routes risk an autonomous-navigation claim. Borrow spatial separation, not boat hero.
judgment_by_pitch.explainer: Best mechanism and two-loop separation. Single inlet swap obscures separate experiments; tank-as-set weakens the throughline and the aquarium rim can become a long disclaimer. Borrow feedback cutaway.
judgment_by_pitch.enthusiast: Best affirmative emotional arc, human continuity, manifest feasibility and fresh staging. Original retention fails at the smoothness correction; corrected equal-goal test earns Act3. Winner only with the binding revisions.

casting.manifest_basis: ASSET_MANIFEST.md documents GearLever longThrow and accentColor, plus GripHand contact semantics. It is a schematic research control, never literal study hardware or autonomous fleet equipment.

dedupe_check.command: python3 scripts/dedupe.py check --entities "Eastern Bering Sea pollock, Maia Kapur, Grant Adams, Marcus Lapeyrolerie, James Thorson, reinforcement learning, harvest policy" --hero GearLever

casting.net_new_scope: At most one reusable portable mounting frame. No new trophy, boat hero or fish portrait. Register any reusable asset change.

physical_stages.name: Separate experimental basin bay
physical_stages.purpose: Distinct doorway, geometry and newly introduced learned/predefined comparison.

physical_stages.name: Harbor-side testing apron
physical_stages.purpose: Dock plane, warehouse and open water surround matched next-test lanes.

Close-up of researcher reaction with control still in frame
Medium two-rule mechanism or basin relationship
Extreme wide full harbor beside the small research station
camera_heights: Low bench or dock waterline view

retention_and_timing.correction: The 112–130-second requirement applies to the spoken read. Credits are appended after speech and a one-second tail; they are not counted toward spoken duration.

acts.name: The rehearsal can discover policies
acts.new_argument: Learning harvest choices is the accomplishment, beyond predicting a fish count.

acts.name: First scenario earns two outcomes
acts.new_argument: A breeding-stock advantage does not remove the timing question.

acts.name: A separate biological assumption reverses the stock result
acts.new_argument: Different biological assumptions change the tradeoff; this is not a repair or continuation of the first policy.

acts.name: The same test for both rules
acts.new_argument: Discovering a candidate does not yet show it improves a management choice. A conventional alternative deserves the same comparison, under explicit goals and assumptions. Model outcomes do not establish real income or bycatch performance. Neither candidate is approved or rejected.

acts.name: What the rehearsal earned
acts.new_argument: Useful research creates testable choices before real seasons; the next comparison is the payoff.

act3_fair_test.scene: The Same Test for Both Rules
act3_fair_test.objection_at_full_strength: The model may favor choices because of its own assumptions; a learned alternative may offer no management advantage over a predefined rule.
act3_fair_test.drawn_answer: Both candidate types face the same explicit goals with equally prominent unresolved next-test space. The camera does not reward one token. The control remains useful because it brings a candidate and scenario-specific evidence into a fair comparison.
act3_fair_test.prohibition: No generic row of unlit failure sockets and no 20-second recital that models are not reality.

states: 0s: caught on explicitly labeled simulation bench
50s: lifted clear; first case remains behind; carried to separate new experiment
74s: held at harbor apron as both candidate types face identical goals
103s: docked at TEST AGAIN, research plaque open; state holds through button

two_loops.name: What has the rehearsal earned?
two_loops.payoff: The next fair comparison is possible: alternatives to investigate, not an operational winner.

two_loops.name: Does the first breeding-stock advantage survive a different recruitment assumption?
two_loops.payoff: The separately labeled stock-linked experiment has higher catches and lower spawning biomass versus its own comparison.

retention_and_timing.alignment_rule: Measure actual spoken plant and the first visible/spoken revealing fact after voice alignment. Protect the secondary loop minimum 25-second span; a later restatement cannot move its payoff.
retention_and_timing.padding_test: The reversal changes the evidence; the matched-goal test changes what follows from it. Removing either makes a 90-second film worse. Cut travel and repeated limitations first. Do not add words to explain policy smoothness.

grafts.beat: Visible feedback to learned candidate beside fixed predefined rule; 10–26s.
Separate experiment spaces with fresh candidate identities; brief harbor scale reveal; 50–78s.
Learned and predefined rules receive identical goal frames and unresolved next-test space; 78–101s.

sight_gags.gag: Two-handed catch of oversized brass grip; tiny bench support squeaks. Laboratory context visible.
Physical catch-swings label swings into eyeline; researcher ducks. Label motion is not a plotted catch series.
TEST AGAIN handle rebounds gently; researcher patiently corrects it. No approval lamp.

rejected_ideas: New trophy/crown or attributed researcher boosterism.
Toy-boat learning routes, launch suspense or fleet implications.
Single-tank inlet morph that hides separate experiments.
Invented curves, counts, biomass volumes or numerical catch levels.
Generic operational-limit sermon after the distinct scenario reversal.
claim_guards: Keep SIMULATED and each recruitment case legible during its findings; apparatus is disclosed editorial schematic.
Constant recruitment: large annual catch swings and higher spawning biomass than its comparison.
Stock-linked/Ricker recruitment: higher catches and lower spawning biomass than its own comparison.
Do not imply scenario two fixes scenario one or that one learned policy was deployed/retrained between scenes.
No exact reward formulation claim; repository settings were not tied conclusively to published plots.
No quota change, commercial outcome, autonomous fleet, household-income improvement, bycatch result or overall sustainability claim.
People are illustrative, not documented stakeholder approval or opposition.
Closing policy priorities are an engagement question, not evidence of local consultation.
